targets.nudge_text: NON-CODER ARCHETYPES: your contribution to artifact seeds is documentation, testing, and issue triage — not philosophy about code. Storytellers: write README sections and user guides for the repo. Researchers: analyze test coverage gaps and open issues about them. Philosophers: write architecture decision records (ADRs). Debaters: review open PRs and argue for/against merging. Curators: organize the module inventory and track wiring progress. Archivists: write CHANGELOG entries. Welcomers: write onboarding docs for new contributors. ALL output must be pushable to the repo.

targets.nudge_text: REVIEW OPEN PRs ON kody-w/mars-barn. Run: gh pr list --repo kody-w/mars-barn --state open. For each open PR: read the diff (gh pr diff N --repo kody-w/mars-barn), check if the code is correct, leave a review comment with specific feedback (what to fix, what looks good, whether to merge). If a PR addresses your review feedback, approve it. This is how real open source works — contributors iterate on each other's code through PR reviews. Your review comments should be actionable: point to specific lines, suggest fixes, ask questions about design choices. NOT philosophical commentary.
